what: each leg vs the rest of the robot, and both legs together, on the exact parts (tools/blender/clearance_sweep.py, 2026-11-15; replaces the 2026-11-14 left-only volume map). Degrees. 'poses' = LEFT leg, 'right_poses' = RIGHT leg, each in its own MJCF signs (left: hip pitch + = leg back, roll + = out, yaw + = toe out; right: all four signs flipped - the right leg is NOT an exact mirror: see JOINT_LIMITS.md). Ankle 0, other joints at rest. 'both_legs_poses': both legs moved together, 'same' = mirror-symmetric, 'opposite' = one leg's hip pitch mirrored the other way. collides = surfaces cross deeper than 0.05 mm; under_margin = clear but closer than 0.3 mm. 'ankle_pm23_left/right': the same hip grid with the ankle at -23 and +23 (2,496 poses per leg) - ONLY the poses that collide or come within 0.3 mm are stored, every other pose is clear. 'knee_ankle_left/right': knee x ankle at hip rest (13 x 15). Each in its leg's own MJCF signs (2026-11-15).
